messages.author: Yasser Almeida
messages.body:
Hello,
I want to link both DFTB+ and xTB into  AMBER (pmemd24). I could compile
XTB but I am struggling with DFTB+.
I following the instructions in section 10.6 2.b (pages 193 and 194).

-DHYBRID_CONFIG_METHODS="Find" -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$XTBHOME

messages.author: Timothy Giese
messages.body: I tried to compile xtb and dftbplus today but recent changes in dftbplus now require a much newer compiler than I have installed, and I don't have the time today to install a newer compiler.  I would recommend trying the last tagged release from the dftbplus github site rather than the most recent main branch commit. I see it is version 24.1 from Feb 2024:  https://github.com/dftbplus/dftbplus/tags
